Geographies Served Programs Mission Disha District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra Mission Disha conducts proactive screenings and interventions for heavy vehicle drivers to address prevalent refractive errors, reducing the risk of accidents and lifetime challenges due to visual impairment. Through screening camps at major hubs, it provides eye health education and recommends spectacles or surgery as necessary, aiming to promote "Vision at Workplaces" and extend its outreach to other public vehicle drivers and skilled workers. Mission Jeevan District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra Mission Jeevan, an initiative by Mission for Vision, addresses the critical issue of retinoblastoma, a prevalent form of eye cancer affecting young children. With over 2,500 cases diagnosed annually in India alone, early detection and treatment are imperative. Through timely screening, counselling, financial assistance, and treatment, the programme ensures that 95% of diagnosed children survive, 90% retain their eyes, and 85% maintain their vision. Additionally, it raises awareness among medical professionals and the public while advocating for policy changes to improve retinoblastoma management. fields.description: Blindness is largely a consequence of poverty and people with visual impairment are more likely to become economically challenged if eye care is inaccessible. The certainty that eradicating avoidable blindness enhances productivity and leads to social and economic equality powered MFV to provide the underprivileged communities with access to the right treatment at the right time.
